verdict.rationale: The Jules API exposes an optional `automationMode` field. By default no PR is created automatically, which implies setting this field makes Jules open one on completion (jules-docs-11). Jules is also documented as creating a PR of its changes (jules-docs-8), and community users describe coming home to PRs it produced (jules-comm-12, jules-comm-6). Missing for 10: the exact automationMode value and its behavior are not documented in the evidence, there is no evidence the setting is available outside the API (e.g. web UI), and no hands-on report specifically confirms automatic PR creation on completion.
